records.name: Invalid initial IFC is rejected without a false success or stuck loading state
Real web-ifc WASM parses the six-element IFC and exposes three Mark groups
The file chooser opens through keyboard activation
Button/keyboard playback share one timer; keyboard pause stays paused and slider arrows advance once
Parameter CSV download contains every actual IFC Express ID
A bad second import preserves the active document, selected parameter and rendered geometry
Value-group filtering changes real rendered geometry
Document switching restores the first document's isolation and camera
Single-group parameters work, and clearing the parameter disables stale playback/export
Light mode changes the live WebGL canvas and active geometry contrast
Closing all documents releases the viewer and stored theme survives a reload

limits: IFC2X3 six-element fixture only; large/corrupt schema coverage and native Windows GUI/installer remain unverified.
CSV exports parameters; IFC authoring/export is not implemented.
